name: Tennessee
overview: Tennessee reimburses qualifying elderly and disabled owners for property taxes and separately authorizes local-option senior tax freezes.

programs.name: Property Tax Relief for Elderly and Disabled Homeowners
programs.ageRule: 65 or older by December 31, 2025, or qualifying disability by that date.
programs.incomeDefinition: Previous-year income from all sources of applicant, spouse, co-owner and resident remainderman.
programs.maximumBenefit: Tax attributable to up to $32,700 market value, limited to eligible property taxes.
programs.formulaSummary: State reimburses qualifying paid residential property tax on the statutory value limit; local rates determine the payment.
programs.application: Apply through county trustee or city collecting official after the tax bill; deadline generally 35 days after delinquency.
programs.programYear: 2025 property-tax relief using 2024 household income; applications follow the property-tax bill.

sources.title: 2025 state Tax Relief brochure hosted by Bristol

programs.name: Disabled Veteran and Surviving Spouse Property Tax Relief
programs.ageRule: Qualifying disabled veteran or surviving spouse; age-independent.
programs.incomeDefinition: The inventory does not establish the 2025 income definition.
programs.maximumBenefit: Tax attributable to up to $175,000 market value.
programs.formulaSummary: Reimbursement based on qualifying property taxes and veteran disability or survivor requirements.
programs.application: Apply through county trustee/city collecting official with VA consent and evidence.
programs.programYear: 2025 property-tax relief; applications follow the property-tax bill.

sources.title: 2025 state Tax Relief brochure hosted by Bristol

programs.name: Property Tax Freeze
programs.incomeLimits: County-specific; local optional limits can differ.
programs.maximumBenefit: Qualifying taxes above established base amount are frozen.
programs.formulaSummary: Available only in adopting counties and municipalities; improvements and ownership changes can affect base.
programs.application: Annual application with participating local collecting official.
programs.programYear: 2025 local property-tax freeze with annual applications; the exact income reference year is not established.

laterChanges: 2026 relief uses a $38,470 2025-income ceiling and $33,600 elderly/disabled market-value cap; those amounts apply to the 2026 relief year.
researchNotes: Tax relief is reimbursement, not an assessed-value exemption; local tax freeze is a separate program.

sources.title: 2025 state Tax Relief brochure hosted by Bristol
